name: 不锈钢速热三层防烫电水壶款
description: 磨砂不锈钢壶身、食品级内胆、三层防烫、快速沸腾

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-blue #10151C for drama and CTA shots, seamless white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, muted warm beige #D8CBBB for lifestyle scenes; clean studio depth, no busy textures
styleLock.lightingSystem: two controlled modes: bright even high-key studio light with soft contact shadows for white shots, dramatic low-key with rim light and controlled speculars for dark shots; light direction always declared
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark reflective studio ground, matte light surfaces for infographics, light oak-toned tabletop for scenes
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in #FFFFFF on dark shots and #2D2D2D on light shots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons, single accent color, rounded label chips
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered product presentation, consistent product scale across the set, brushed steel rendered with controlled highlights, no warping of straight lines, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal-blue background #10151C, clean white #FFFFFF, muted warm beige #D8CBBB and one signal-red accent #C0272D; neutral tone; brushed stainless steel rendered with controlled highlights and soft contact shadows; bright even high-key lighting for white shots and dramatic low-key lighting with rim light for dark shots; modern geometric sans-serif headline type, white #FFFFFF on dark shots and charcoal #2D2D2D on light shots; consistent thin-line icons and rounded label chips; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable centered product presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no fake brand marks.
